The autoplot() Generic of ggplot2

Source: R/ggplot.R
autoplot.Rd

The generic autoplot() belongs to ggplot2, which this package suggests and does not import. The methods written on it here are registered by S7::methods_register() when ggplot2 is loaded.

Usage

autoplot

Format

An object of class S7_external_generic of length 4.

Value

An S7 external generic, the description of ggplot2::autoplot() that S7::method() registers methods on.
